item.tib: ma cig srid pa rgyal mo'i nang bdud mo ru sgrub pa'i srog gi gzer bu'i cha lag blo'i tha ram 'byed pa'i lde mig
item.coloph: bstan srung gtso mo ma mchog rgyal mo la/ bstan pa srung ba'i 'phrin bcol cha rkyen 'di/ bstan 'dzin skyes bu rnams kyi phyag cha ru/ bstan la srid zhur bgyis pa'i tshe snying pas/ rnam dkar 'dod pa'i blo yis nyer drangs nas/ rnam dag 'dod blos bskul nas 'di nyid bris/ rnam rmongs gzhung lugs ma khrol 'gal ba'i skyon/ rnam mkhyen lha dang bla ma'i spyan sngar bshags/ 'di 'dra'i legs bshad 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur thal/ 'di bris dge tshogs shig snying tsam srid na'ang / 'di phyi'i don gnyis 'grub pa'i rgyur gyur te/ 'di yis ma gyur srid mtsho sgrol mdzad smon//

item.tib: ma cig srid pa'i rgyal mo'i nang bdud mo ru sgrub pa'i srog gi gzer bu'i cha lag blo yi tha ram 'byed pa'i lde mig
item.coloph: ces srid pa'i rgyal mo nang bdud mo ru sgrub pa'i srog gi gzer bu'i cha lag rgyud pi wang ldir ba'i sgra dbyangs 'di nyid shel skyes tshe dbang bde chen snying pos shar grol smin gling du bris pa 'dis kyang g.yung drung bon bstan rin po che nub med dar zhing rgyas pa'i rgyur gyur cig
